correctness.rationale: Independently write B/m=e^(−at)+1_{t≥d}e^(−a(t−d)) and the swapped quality difference (Q_HL−Q_LH)/(mΔq)=e^(−bt)−1_{t≥d}e^(−b(t−d)). Their product integrates on [0,d] to E/c and on [d,H] to −(1+e^(−ad))(1−e^(−bd))(1−z)/c, where z=e^(−c(H−d)). This proves the contrast, including H=d, since (1+e^(−ad))(1−e^(−bd))=E+D>0. The contrast decreases strictly for H>d from m²Δq E/c>0 to −m²Δq D/c. Thus it crosses once iff a<b; when a=b it stays positive at finite H and tends to zero. Solving for z=D/(E+D) gives the claimed H_c and cancellation of mass and quality. As d→0, E/d→c and D/d→b−a, giving log(2b/(b−a))/c, while the contrast is O(d) uniformly on H≥d. As d→∞, D=e^(−ad)(1−e^(−(b−a)d)) and log(1+E/D)=ad+o(1), giving the other stated limit. Four-term numerical convolution quadrature independently agrees with both displayed response pairs and sampled boundary/regime cases.
